verdict.rationale: `bun install` works as a one-command install in any project with a package.json. It covers all workspaces in a monorepo and installs from the lockfile, with `--frozen-lockfile` for exact reproducible versions. It also migrates existing npm, yarn and pnpm lockfiles automatically. Community users report that isolated installs make monorepo installs more reliable, though some hit install crashes that required deleting lockfiles and node_modules. Missing for 10: dependency lifecycle scripts such as postinstall do not run by default unless listed in `trustedDependencies`, the install-crash reports are unresolved, and there is no independent hands-on confirmation of a clean fresh-clone bootstrap.
